meta.title: Mobile MACD — Journey 1 (Plan Change, Park My Number & Resume, Disconnection & Retention, Prepaid-to-Postpaid Migration) — Process Flow

lanes.name: Trigger / Journey
lanes.hint: Journey and Session Management (JSM) — one MACD action per queue ticket/session

lanes.name: Retail / Telesales Agent
lanes.hint: Customer verification, cart, eligibility, checkout, contract, payment, submission

lanes.name: Retention Agent
lanes.hint: Retention ticket handling, offer, cart and closure (Disconnection capability only)

lanes.name: Approver
lanes.hint: Agent Task View / Agent Approval View (Prepaid Balance Adjustment Approval, Pre-to-Post capability only)

lanes.name: DXP / Billing / Network / Order Fulfilment / Systems
lanes.hint: WinCash, Billing System, UIM, Order Management, Notification Platform, Medilia

nodes.label: MACD Journey Triggered
nodes.sub: Journey1: Plan Change / Park & Resume / Disconnection / Pre-to-Post
nodes.desc: One MACD process (Plan Change, Park My Number, Disconnection, or Prepaid-to-Postpaid Migration) is initiated per queue ticket/session, reusing Journey and Session Management (JSM) from the Mobile Postpaid Activation and Trouble Ticket journeys.
outputs: Active journey/session context

nodes.label: Select MACD Capability
nodes.desc: The four Journey 1 capabilities share initiation (JSM), verification (KYC/CAV) and ticket creation (CRE), then branch by the specific MACD action the agent selects from Customer 360.

nodes.label: Search Customer
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the agent to search customer by MSISDN, Customer No, First Name or Last Name and display Customer 360.
outputs: Customer 360 displayed

nodes.label: Customer Selection
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to pick the specific MSISDN from the list of MSISDN (if the customer has more than one MSISDN under the same account) on which the customer wants to initiate the plan change.
outputs: Selected MSISDN for plan change

nodes.label: Initiate Plan Change
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to initiate the plan change.
outputs: Plan change order raised

nodes.label: Eligibility & Credit Control (ECC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ECC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Cardinality Check
nodes.desc: The system shall apply the cardinality rule applicable for the plan-change request and allow only the plans that come under the cardinality rule.
outputs: Only cardinality-permitted plans selectable; violating plans excluded/blocked with message

nodes.label: Compatibility Check
nodes.desc: The system shall apply the compatibility rule applicable for the plan-change request and allow only the plans that come under the compatibility rule.
outputs: Only compatibility-permitted plans selectable; incompatible plans excluded/blocked with message

nodes.label: Plan Lock-In Validation
nodes.desc: The system shall validate the customer's plan commitment status before permitting the Retail Agent to proceed with the plan-change journey.
outputs: Lock-in validation outcome recorded

nodes.label: Product Catalogue & Cart (QPC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (QPC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Plan Upgrade/Downgrade Classification
nodes.desc: The system shall determine and record the plan-change classification for the selected replacement plan.
outputs: Classification recorded: Upgrade, Downgrade or Plan Update

nodes.label: Upgrade Plan Processing
nodes.desc: The system shall process a plan change classified as an Upgrade.
outputs: Upgrade processed; charges displayed; no downgrade/commitment-break penalty

nodes.label: Downgrade Plan Processing
nodes.desc: The system shall process a plan change classified as a Downgrade.
outputs: Downgrade penalty (per matrix) displayed before confirmation; effective immediately

nodes.label: Add-On Carry Forward
nodes.desc: System shall remove bundled add-ons/discounts from the old plan and retain independently purchased add-ons/discounts.
outputs: Bundled add-ons/discounts removed; independent add-ons retained

nodes.label: Add-On Update
nodes.desc: System shall allow agent to update (add/remove) Add-Ons.
outputs: Add-ons added/removed by agent

nodes.label: Discount Update
nodes.desc: System shall allow agent to update the discount.
outputs: Latest discount applied

nodes.label: SIM/MSISDN Protection
nodes.desc: System shall display SIM and MSISDN details to be visible to Agent but in non-editable format.
outputs: MSISDN/SIM shown read-only

nodes.label: Milestone: Cart Saved
nodes.desc: Save Cart milestone — reached either directly (no Credit Limit Enhancement needed) or after the CLE_001 branch completes.

nodes.label: Raise a Ticket/Task
nodes.desc: System should allow agent to create a Ticket/Task to amend the credit limit of the customer, if the new Plan or Add-On purchased is exceeding the default credit limit.
outputs: Credit limit enhancement Ticket/Task created

nodes.label: Assignment of Ticket/Task
nodes.desc: System should assign the Ticket/Task to relevant amendment authority.
outputs: Ticket/Task assigned to designated team

nodes.label: Credit Limit Amendment Authority
nodes.desc: The system shall allow an agent to amend the system-defaulted credit limit only within the range permitted for the customer segment and only where the agent holds the privileged role.
outputs: Non-privileged agent blocked; privileged agent capped at segment ceiling

nodes.label: Credit Limit Escalation to Collections
nodes.desc: The system shall route a credit limit increase beyond the agent-permitted value to the Collections team as an approval ticket because only the Collections role may apply that increase.
outputs: Collections approval ticket created; limit not applied until approved

nodes.label: Credit Limit Advance Payment Collection
nodes.desc: The system shall collect the delta amount between the default and the enhanced credit limit as a refundable deposit before the order is saved.
outputs: Deposit collected = enhanced minus default credit limit

nodes.label: Advanced Payment Utilization
nodes.desc: The system shall adjust the advanced payment in the next Bill cycle.
outputs: Advanced amount adjusted against next bill

nodes.label: Credit Note on Cancellation
nodes.desc: The system shall create and issue a credit note adjustment to the customer where an order carrying a collected payment is cancelled.
outputs: Credit note issued for collected amount

nodes.label: Re-Assigning Ticket to Retention Team
nodes.desc: System shall allow agent to assign the ticket to Retention team, if the plan is getting downgraded.
outputs: Ticket reassigned; Retention Team can access it

nodes.label: Re-Opening the Saved Cart
nodes.desc: System shall allow retention agent to re-open the Cart and update the Plan based on the discussion with the customer.
outputs: Revised cart saved by Retention Agent

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check Out (CVC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CVC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Cart Discount
nodes.desc: System shall overwrite and apply latest valid discount available in cart based on the plan selection.
outputs: Latest discount applied based on plan selection

nodes.label: Milestone: Cart Checked Out, Proceed to Payment
Payment Request to Payment Collection System
nodes.desc: The system shall display the Payment Summary and initiate the payment collection through WinCash for New Plan/Add On, Downgrade Penalty, Commitment Break Penalty, and Advance Payment for Credit Limit Enhancement.
outputs: Payment collected via WinCash; receipt issued

nodes.label: Payment & Inventory (PAY Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (PAY) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Retail Agent to submit the order once all sections are filled and saved and payment completed.
outputs: Order submitted

nodes.label: Order Submission (ORD Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ORD) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Notification & Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (NOT) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Billing Update
nodes.desc: System shall send old Plan/Add On/Discount details which are removed and add New Plan/Add on/Discount to the Billing system.
outputs: Billing updated with new plan effective from Bill Start date; old plan closed at Bill End date

nodes.label: Capture Ticket Feedback
nodes.desc: The system shall trigger customer satisfaction feedback where the feedback pattern is configured.
outputs: Feedback trigger sent, or marked not applicable

nodes.label: End of Plan Change Order Capture Journey
Search Customer
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the agent to search customer by MSISDN, Customer No, First Name or Last Name and display Customer 360.
outputs: Customer 360 displayed

nodes.label: Customer Selection
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to pick the specific MSISDN from the list of MSISDN (if the customer has more than one MSISDN under the same account) on which the customer wants to initiate Park My Number.
outputs: Selected MSISDN for Park My Number

nodes.label: Initiate Park My Number
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the agent to initiate Park My Number Order.
outputs: Park My Number order raised

nodes.label: Validate Outstanding Bill
nodes.desc: The system shall validate outstanding bill before allowing Park My Number.
outputs: Blocked with message if outstanding; proceeds once cleared

nodes.label: Validate Current Unbilled Amount
nodes.desc: The system shall validate current unbilled amount before allowing Park My Number.
outputs: Blocked until cleared or approved exception captured

nodes.label: Validate Collections Status
nodes.desc: The system shall validate that the number/account is not in collections before Park My Number processing.
outputs: Rejected with reason if in collections; proceeds otherwise

nodes.label: Validate Commitment/Lock-In
nodes.desc: The system shall validate whether the customer is under an active commitment/lock-in plan before Park My Number.
outputs: Commitment/lock-in status displayed and stored

nodes.label: Star Number Parked Period
nodes.desc: Where the customer is under commitment (Star Number), the system shall extend the commitment duration by the parked period.
outputs: Commitment extension calculated and stored/passed downstream

nodes.label: Park My Number Eligibility
nodes.desc: The System shall validate the Eligibility to Assign the Park My Number plan to the MSISDN.
outputs: Eligibility checked; error displayed if not eligible; journey stopped

branches.label: Not eligible (parked twice already this year)

nodes.label: Error: Park My Number Not Eligible
nodes.desc: Error displayed and journey stopped when the MSISDN has already used Park My Number twice in the current year, per BR-PMN-006.

nodes.label: Product Catalogue & Cart (QPC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (QPC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Fetch Park Plan from Catalogue
nodes.desc: The system shall fetch Park My Number Plan from catalogue for selection.
outputs: Park Plan displayed for assignment

nodes.label: Assign Park Plan
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the agent to assign the configured Park My Number/Park Plan to the existing MSISDN.
outputs: Park Plan added to cart/order; current MSISDN unchanged

nodes.label: Expire Current Active Plan
nodes.desc: The system shall expire/deactivate the existing active plan when Park Plan is assigned.
outputs: Existing plan marked for expiry; Park Plan becomes target active plan

nodes.label: Retain MSISDN and SIM Details
nodes.desc: The system shall retain existing MSISDN and SIM details and display them as non-editable during the Park My Number plan-change flow.
outputs: MSISDN/SIM shown read-only; agent cannot change them

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check Out (CVC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CVC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Cart Discount
nodes.desc: System shall overwrite and apply latest valid discount available in cart based on the plan selection.
outputs: Latest discount applied

nodes.label: Payment Request to Payment Collection System
nodes.desc: The system shall display the Payment Summary and initiate the payment collection through WinCash for Commitment Break Penalty, Park My Number Plan charges, and Bill Due Payment.
outputs: Payment collected via WinCash based on dues and Park charges

nodes.label: Payment & Inventory (PAY Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (PAY) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Retail Agent to submit the order once all sections are filled and saved and payment completed.
outputs: Order submitted

nodes.label: Order Submission (ORD Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ORD) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Notification & Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (NOT) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Billing Update
nodes.desc: System would continue generating the Bill for Park My Number Plan.
outputs: Billing updated with Park My Number plan from effective date

nodes.label: Capture Ticket Feedback
nodes.desc: The system shall trigger customer satisfaction feedback where the feedback pattern is configured.
outputs: Feedback trigger sent, or marked not applicable

nodes.label: End of Park My Number Order Capture Journey
Journey and Session Management (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (JSM) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer Verification (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CAV) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer Identification (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (KYC) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Ticket Creation (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CRE) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer and Account Management (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CAM) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Eligibility and Credit Control (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ECC) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Skip Validation Checks on Lock-In, Cardinality and Compatibility
nodes.desc: System shall skip all the validation related to Plan Lock-In, Compatibility, Cardinality and allow agent to assign a new plan or existing plan.
outputs: Agent can reassign eligible plan without these checks

nodes.label: Product Catalogue and Cart (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (QPC) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check Out (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CVC) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Payment and Inventory (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (PAY) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Order Submission (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ORD) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Notification and Feedback (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (NOT) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Billing Update
nodes.desc: System would start the billing based on the re-assigned Plan.
outputs: Billing starts for the reassigned plan from its effective date

nodes.label: Star Number Lock Period Continues
nodes.desc: System would start the Star Number lock-in duration after assignment of new Plan.
outputs: Star lock-in period counter starts

nodes.label: Customer Satisfaction Feedback (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CSA) as detailed in the Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: End of Resume Order Capture Journey
Optional Soft ID Scan for Plan Change
nodes.desc: The system shall offer soft ID scanning only when the customer proceeds with a plan change after retention.
outputs: Soft ID scan available for plan change, skipped for direct termination

nodes.label: Mandatory Lightweight Customer Verification
nodes.desc: The system shall perform lightweight customer verification using a questionnaire before the MACD journey progresses.
outputs: CAV completed; verification result recorded

nodes.label: Search Customer
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the agent to search customer by MSISDN, Customer No, First Name or Last Name and display Customer 360.
outputs: Customer 360 displayed

nodes.label: Initiate Termination
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to initiate the Disconnect.
outputs: Disconnect request initiated

nodes.label: Display Dues and Lock-Ins
nodes.desc: The system shall support retention agent review of outstanding bill dues, DOI lock-ins, Star Number lock-in and plan lock-in penalties from Customer 360.
outputs: Dues, DOI penalty and plan penalty visible before retention decision

nodes.label: Payment Summary View
nodes.desc: The system shall display Outstanding Dues and Lock-in Penalty Charges to the agent.
outputs: Pending dues and penalty details displayed

nodes.label: Create Retention Ticket
nodes.desc: The system shall allow creation of a retention ticket for a customer requesting disconnection before any save or termination decision.
outputs: Retention ticket created with customer/service/disconnection context

nodes.label: Retention Team Work Assignment
nodes.desc: The system shall assign the retention ticket to the Retention queue and allow a Retention agent to take ownership.
outputs: Retention agent can self-assign and start work

nodes.label: Retention Offer Outcome
nodes.desc: The Retention Agent presents a retention offer; the customer accepts a retained plan/add-on/discount, rejects and proceeds to termination, or agrees to migrate to Prepaid instead.

nodes.label: Create Cart with Retention Plan/Add-On/Discount
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Retention agent to select an eligible retained postpaid plan, add-on or discount where the customer accepted the Retention offer.
outputs: Eligible retained plan/add-on/discount added to cart

nodes.label: Validate Retention Cart
nodes.desc: The system shall validate the retention cart before payment or order submission.
outputs: Cart validation pass or blocking messages

nodes.label: Plan Change Downgrade Payment Waiver
nodes.desc: System shall not add Downgrade Charges, if Plan Change is happening as part of Retention Ticket.
outputs: No downgrade charge added on active retention ticket

nodes.label: Submit Retained Plan Order
nodes.desc: The system shall submit the retained plan, add-on or discount order after successful validation and payment handling.
outputs: Order submitted; tracking record updated

nodes.label: Send Retained Outcome Notification
nodes.desc: The system shall send customer notification after retained plan order submission or closure where trigger points are configured.
outputs: Notification sent using confirmed template/recipient list

nodes.label: Close Retention Ticket for Retained Customer
nodes.desc: The system shall close the retention ticket when the customer accepts the retained postpaid plan path.
outputs: Ticket closed with retained outcome and resolution reason

nodes.label: Payment Adjustment
nodes.desc: System shall adjust the payment collected during Retention Ticket creation and would be adjusted with next Bill.
outputs: Payment recorded as adjustment on next bill

nodes.label: Capture Retained Feedback
nodes.desc: The system shall trigger customer satisfaction feedback where the feedback pattern is configured for retained outcome.
outputs: Feedback trigger sent, or marked not applicable

nodes.label: Retention Offer Rejected
nodes.desc: The system shall allow retention agent to record rejection and request dues and penalties clearance.
outputs: Rejection recorded; customer asked to clear dues/lock-in penalties

nodes.label: Termination Order Cancellation
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to close Ticket and cancel the termination request where customer requested disconnection but failed to clear dues within 72 hours.
outputs: Ticket ID, outstanding amount, closure reason captured; no disconnection order placed

nodes.label: Dues and Penalties Pending — Dunning
nodes.desc: The system shall consider the MSISDN under Dunning Cycle due to non-payment of pending penalties and dues.
outputs: MSISDN considered for Termination under Dunning journey

nodes.label: Customer Not Reachable
nodes.desc: The system shall support handling where customer cannot be reached within 72 hours; Retention Agent should be able to submit the Termination Order and close the Retention Ticket when all dues are cleared.
outputs: Disconnection order placed if dues cleared; Retention Ticket closed

nodes.label: Capture Disconnection Order
nodes.desc: The system shall allow Agent to capture Disconnection order, with Termination Reason, Linked Retention Ticket (if any), Termination Date, MSISDN selection under the Billing Account.
outputs: Customer Number, Disconnect Reason and Disconnection Date captured

nodes.label: Collect Termination Payment
nodes.desc: The system shall display Star Number penalty, DOI remaining installment, outstanding dues and Plan lock-in (if not already paid) and block progression until payment is collected.
outputs: Payment collected before progression; receipt generated

nodes.label: Disconnection Order Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall allow Agent to place disconnection order after Payment is verified.
outputs: Disconnection order placed once payment completed

nodes.label: Deactivate Network Service
nodes.desc: The system shall deactivate the network service after the disconnection order enters fulfilment.
outputs: Network deactivation outcome linked to disconnection order

nodes.label: Update Number Status
nodes.desc: The system shall update the MSISDN status after network deactivation in accordance with number-management rules.
outputs: MSISDN status updated; outcome linked to disconnection order

nodes.label: Deactivate SIM
nodes.desc: The system shall update or deactivate the SIM after the number status is processed.
outputs: SIM status updated; outcome linked to disconnection order

nodes.label: Complete Financial Closure
nodes.desc: The system shall complete final billing and financial account closure after fulfilment while retaining final-bill generation at bill-cycle end.
outputs: Financial closure recorded; final bill scheduled at bill-cycle end

nodes.label: Send Feedback Survey
nodes.desc: The system shall trigger a feedback survey after termination resolution where configured.
outputs: Survey trigger sent only after termination fulfilment and resolution complete

nodes.label: Retention Offer Rejected — Migrate to Prepaid
nodes.desc: The system shall allow retention agent to record rejection reason and capture Migration to Prepaid Request in the Ticket, and close the Ticket.
outputs: Rejection reason and Post-to-Pre migration request recorded; retention ticket closed

nodes.label: Raise Adjustment Ticket
nodes.desc: The system shall support billing profile change from Postpaid to Prepaid and ticket creation for refunds or adjustments where applicable. Any advance payment available in the Postpaid account must be adjusted to Prepaid Balance.
outputs: Adjustment raised only if bill cycle processed before disconnection; overpayments adjusted to Prepaid Main Balance

nodes.label: Initiate Post to Pre
nodes.desc: The system shall allow Post to Pre migration only for Mobile service with Connection Type Postpaid.
outputs: Journey blocked unless service is Mobile Postpaid

nodes.label: Optional Soft ID Scan for Post to Pre Plan Change
nodes.desc: The system shall offer soft ID scanning only when required for the Post to Pre plan-change path.
outputs: Soft ID scanning completed or skipped after mandatory CAV; decision recorded

nodes.label: Collect Migration Payment
nodes.desc: The system shall display Plan Lock-in penalty, Star Number penalty, DOI remaining installment, outstanding dues and migration fees and block progression until payment is collected.
outputs: Payment collected before progression; receipt generated

nodes.label: Post to Pre Cart Creation
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to create order with eligible prepaid plan and add eligible add-ons or discounts.
outputs: Bill Limit blank; charges recalculated; SIM/MSISDN shown but not removable/updatable

nodes.label: Billing Profile Update
nodes.desc: The system shall remove Postpaid billing details and make Billing Profile not applicable for prepaid connection type.
outputs: Billing Account selection restricted for Prepaid Connection Type

nodes.label: Validate Cart
nodes.desc: The system shall perform customer, account, MSISDN, SIM, plan, eligibility and compatibility validations before payment.
outputs: Order progression blocked until mandatory validations complete

nodes.label: Payment Processing
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to view payment summary and initiate payment through WinCash for base plan and chargeable add-ons.
outputs: Payment status updated in CRM; held/retry on failure

nodes.label: Key Information
nodes.desc: System should generate the Terms and Conditions related to Prepaid; rest of the CAF capability reused from Mobile Postpaid activation.
outputs: Prepaid Key Information generated

nodes.label: Send CAF Through Email
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to send CAF documents via email, if the customer is not at counter.
outputs: CAF sent to customer email

nodes.label: CAF Generation and Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall generate the Prepaid CAF, signed by Customer, and should be saved before submission.
outputs: CAF generated, signed and saved before submission

nodes.label: Order Submission and Migration
nodes.desc: The system shall submit Post to Pre order after successful payment and terminate postpaid connection after prepaid activation.
outputs: Order submitted downstream; Postpaid terminated after Prepaid activation; SIM/MSISDN inventory updated

nodes.label: Customer Notification at Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall send order submission notification to customer through selected mode.
outputs: Submission notification sent when trigger point/template/recipient available

nodes.label: Customer Notification Completion
nodes.desc: The system shall send order completion acknowledgement to customer and to all MSISDNs under QID where applicable.
outputs: Completion notification sent to all MSISDNs under the QID

nodes.label: End: Migrated to Prepaid, Postpaid Disconnected
Assign to TeleSales Queue
nodes.desc: The system shall assign the Prepaid to Postpaid Migration ticket to the Telesales queue and allow a Telesales Agent to take ownership.
outputs: Ticket visible in Telesales queue; Telesales Agent can self-assign

nodes.label: Customer and Account Management (Reuse: Plan Change)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CAM) as detailed in Mobile Plan Change Journey (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Initiate Migration Order
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Telesales Agent to initiate a Prepaid to Postpaid Migration order from the selected active prepaid service in Customer 360.
outputs: Migration order created and linked to Ticket and selected prepaid MSISDN

nodes.label: Customer Identification (KYC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (KYC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Customer Verification — Light Weight (CAV Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CAV) as detailed in Trouble Ticket Journey (TT_001).

nodes.label: Latest Identity Type Eligibility
nodes.desc: The system shall use the latest successfully verified identity type for Postpaid eligibility assessment.
outputs: Customer assessed using latest verified identity, irrespective of prior Prepaid identity

nodes.label: Refresh Customer Information
nodes.desc: The system shall update the existing customer record with the latest verified customer information returned through the MOI validation process.
outputs: Customer record reflects latest verified identity attributes

nodes.label: Eligibility and Credit Control (ECC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ECC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001), except where a migration-specific rule applies.

nodes.label: Prepaid Service Migration Eligibility
nodes.desc: The system shall permit migration only where the selected service is Mobile, the connection type is Prepaid and the service status is Active, and the migration-specific rule applies.
outputs: Journey blocked with distinct message if any condition unmet

nodes.label: Postpaid Service Migration Eligibility
nodes.desc: The system shall determine Postpaid eligibility from the latest verified identity type in accordance with the Postpaid Activation eligibility rule.
outputs: Only customer with a Postpaid-permitted identity type can proceed

nodes.label: Error: Migration Not Eligible
nodes.desc: Journey blocked with a distinct message when the Prepaid service or Postpaid identity-type eligibility conditions are not met, per BR-PTPO-012/BR-PTPO-009.

nodes.label: Billing Account Management (BAM Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (BAM) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Create or Select Billing Account
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Telesales Agent to create a Postpaid billing account or select an eligible existing billing account for the migrated MSISDN.
outputs: Exactly one eligible billing account associated with the migrated subscription

nodes.label: Postpaid Payment Profile
nodes.desc: The system shall require an active Postpaid payment profile before the cart can be checked out.
outputs: Checkout blocked without active payment profile

nodes.label: Product Catalogue and Cart (QPC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (QPC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001), excluding new Number and SIM selection.

nodes.label: Eligible Postpaid Plan Selection
nodes.desc: The system shall display Postpaid base plans, add-ons and discounts for which the customer is eligible based on the refreshed customer profile and connection type.
outputs: Only eligible Postpaid offers selectable

nodes.label: Retain Existing MSISDN
nodes.desc: The system shall carry the existing prepaid MSISDN into the migration cart and display it as non-editable.
outputs: Retained MSISDN present in cart; agent cannot remove/replace/select another

nodes.label: Retain Existing SIM
nodes.desc: The system shall carry the existing prepaid SIM and ICCID into the migration cart and display them as non-editable.
outputs: Retained SIM/ICCID present in cart; agent cannot add/remove/replace/regenerate

nodes.label: Apply New Postpaid Promotions
nodes.desc: The system shall apply only the Postpaid plans, add-ons, discounts and promotions selected or defaulted for the new Postpaid subscription.
outputs: Order summary contains only new eligible Postpaid products, excludes prepaid promotions

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check Out (CVC Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CVC) as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001), with retained MSISDN and SIM validations.

nodes.label: Migration Cart Validation
nodes.desc: The system shall validate customer, KYC, CAV, eligibility, billing account, payment profile, retained MSISDN, retained SIM and selected Postpaid Plan before checkout completes.
outputs: Checkout blocked until all mandatory migration validations pass

nodes.label: Migration Order Summary
nodes.desc: The system shall display the prepaid products to be terminated, retained MSISDN and SIM, new Postpaid Plans, payable amount and prepaid balance treatment before confirmation.
outputs: Consolidated summary displayed and confirmed before proceeding

nodes.label: New Postpaid CAF Required?
nodes.desc: The system shall determine from configuration whether a new Postpaid CAF is required for the Prepaid to Postpaid Migration order.
outputs: Progression permitted without CAF where rule returns Optional/Not Required

nodes.label: Send CAF Through Email
nodes.desc: The system shall allow agent to send CAF documents via email, if the customer is not at counter.
outputs: CAF sent to customer email

nodes.label: Generate CAF Key Information (Postpaid Template)
nodes.desc: Where CAF is required or selected, the process shall follow MPAR_001_CAF_* from the Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey.
outputs: Generated/uploaded CAF follows Postpaid Activation template, content, signature and document rules

nodes.label: Payment and Inventory (PAY Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same payment request, failure, retry, receipt and billing posting capability as detailed in Mobile Postpaid Activation Journey.

nodes.label: Migration Payment Summary
nodes.desc: The system shall display applicable upfront Postpaid charges, deposits and other migration charges, including the remaining prepaid balance.
outputs: Payment summary itemises Postpaid onboarding charges; applies prepaid balance as credit

nodes.label: Prepaid Balance Adjustment Approval
nodes.desc: System would raise Prepaid Balance Approval Task and assigned to respective agent.
outputs: Prepaid Adjustment Approval Task raised and assigned

nodes.label: Agent Task View (ATV Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (ATV) as detailed in Agent 360 (AGN_AGT_360_RET_001).

nodes.label: Agent Approval View (AAV Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (AAV) as detailed in Agent 360 (AGN_AGT_360_RET_001).

nodes.label: Restrict Agent Action While Pending
nodes.desc: The system shall prevent agents from submitting or dropping Migration (Pre to Post) orders in pending approval state.
outputs: Only approver can approve or reject an order pending approval

nodes.label: Migration Order Submission
nodes.desc: The system shall allow the Telesales Agent to submit the migration order after all mandatory sections, validations, optional CAF decision and payment handling are complete.
outputs: Submission enabled only when complete and payment Paid or Zero Value Completed

nodes.label: Route Migration for Fulfilment
nodes.desc: The system shall send the migration order to Order Management with the prepaid plans terminated and retained MSISDN and SIM, Postpaid billing account and selected Postpaid products.
outputs: Order Management receives complete migration order with all required line items

nodes.label: Migration Order Linked to Ticket
nodes.desc: The system shall link the submitted migration order number and status to the Ticket.
outputs: Ticket displays migration order number and latest status

nodes.label: Notification and Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (NOT) as detailed in Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001).

nodes.label: Migration Template Notification
nodes.desc: The system shall notify the customer when the migration order is submitted.
outputs: Preconfigured Pre-to-Post template triggered

nodes.label: Terminate Prepaid Subscription
nodes.desc: The system shall terminate the existing prepaid subscription and all associated prepaid plans, bundles, add-ons, discounts and promotions only as part of successful migration completion.
outputs: No active prepaid commercial products remain on the retained MSISDN

nodes.label: Prepaid Balance Adjustment
nodes.desc: The system shall transfer the Prepaid main balance against the Postpaid Billing account.
outputs: Postpaid billing account credited with prepaid main balance amount

nodes.label: Activate Postpaid Billing
nodes.desc: The system shall activate Postpaid billing for the selected plan, add-ons and discounts from the applicable migration completion date.
outputs: Billing system reflects active Postpaid subscription with applicable charges

nodes.label: Retain MSISDN and SIM After Migration
nodes.desc: The system shall maintain the existing MSISDN and SIM association when the service connection type changes from Prepaid to Postpaid.
outputs: Completed Postpaid subscription carries same MSISDN and SIM/ICCID

nodes.label: Order and Ticket Completion
nodes.desc: The system shall set the migration order to Completed, update the Tracking Record and close the Ticket with the migration outcome after successful fulfilment and billing update.
outputs: Order number, completed status and migration resolution outcome recorded

nodes.label: Customer Satisfaction Feedback (CSA Capability Reuse)
nodes.desc: Note: the process will follow the same capability (CSA) as detailed in Plan Change Requirement (MOB_POST_PLN_CHG_RETL_001).
