start.title: MACD Journey Triggered
start.does: Starts one of the four Mobile MACD Journey 1 capabilities (Plan Change, Park My Number/Resume, Disconnection/Retention/Post-to-Pre, or Prepaid-to-Postpaid Migration), reusing the Journey and Session Management (JSM) capability from the Mobile Postpaid Activation and Trouble Ticket journeys.
start.makes: An active journey/session for the selected MACD capability.
start.example: Retail agent opens Customer 360 and starts a Plan Change, Park My Number, Disconnection, or Migration request.

branch_capability.title: Select MACD Capability
branch_capability.does: Represents the point at which the shared journey/verification/ticket steps diverge into one of the four Journey 1 capabilities.
branch_capability.needs: Completed Journey and Session Management, Customer Identification/Verification (KYC) and Customer Authentication/Verification (CAV), and Ticket Creation & Categorisation (CRE) — each reused from the Mobile Postpaid Activation and Trouble Ticket journeys.
branch_capability.makes: Routing into the Plan Change, Park My Number/Resume, Disconnection, or Prepaid-to-Postpaid Migration path.
branch_capability.example: Agent completes verification and ticket creation, then selects the MACD action for the customer's request.

pc_cam_search.title: Search Customer
pc_cam_search.does: Allows the agent to search the customer by MSISDN, Customer No, First Name or Last Name and display Customer 360.
pc_cam_search.makes: Customer 360 view for the matched customer.
pc_cam_search.example: Agent searches by MSISDN and opens Customer 360.

pc_cam_select.title: Customer Selection
pc_cam_select.does: Lets the agent pick the specific MSISDN under a multi-MSISDN account for the plan change.
pc_cam_select.needs: List of MSISDN under the account.
pc_cam_select.makes: Selected MSISDN on which the plan change is initiated.
pc_cam_select.example: Customer has 3 lines; agent picks the one requesting a plan change.

pc_cam_initiate.title: Initiate Plan Change
pc_cam_initiate.does: Lets the agent raise a plan-change order for the selected MSISDN, one MSISDN at a time per BR-MPC-015.
pc_cam_initiate.example: Agent clicks 'Initiate Plan Change' for the selected line.

pc_ecc_ref.title: Eligibility & Credit Control (ECC Capability Reuse)
pc_ecc_ref.does: Reuses the ECC capability from the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey for baseline eligibility/credit checks.
pc_ecc_ref.example: Standard ECC checks run before the plan-change-specific validations below.

pc_ecc_cardinality.title: Cardinality Check
pc_ecc_cardinality.does: Restricts the plan-change selection to plans permitted by the applicable cardinality rule.
pc_ecc_cardinality.needs: Cardinality rule and candidate plan list.
pc_ecc_cardinality.makes: Filtered/selectable plan list; violating plans blocked with a message.
pc_ecc_cardinality.example: Agent tries a plan that violates cardinality; it is excluded with an explanatory message.

pc_ecc_compat.title: Compatibility Check
pc_ecc_compat.does: Restricts the plan-change selection to plans permitted by the applicable compatibility rule.
pc_ecc_compat.needs: Compatibility rule and candidate plan list.
pc_ecc_compat.makes: Filtered/selectable plan list; incompatible plans blocked with a message.
pc_ecc_compat.example: Agent tries an incompatible plan; it is excluded with an explanatory message.

pc_ecc_lockin.title: Plan Lock-In Validation
pc_ecc_lockin.does: Validates the customer's plan commitment (lock-in) status before allowing the plan change to proceed, per BR-MPC-001.
pc_ecc_lockin.makes: Recorded lock-in outcome; next action per BR-MPC-001 (proceed, or require/reject penalty).
pc_ecc_lockin.example: Customer is 1 month into a 3-month lock-in; system flags a penalty is required to proceed with a downgrade.

pc_qpc_ref.title: Product Catalogue & Cart (QPC Capability Reuse)
pc_qpc_ref.does: Reuses the QPC capability from Mobile Postpaid Activation for baseline cart creation.
pc_qpc_ref.example: Standard QPC flow runs before the plan-change-specific cart rules below.

pc_qpc_classify.title: Plan Upgrade/Downgrade Classification
pc_qpc_classify.does: Compares current vs new base plan price (excluding discounts/add-ons/one-time charges) and classifies the change as Upgrade, Downgrade or Plan Update per BR-MPC-002.
pc_qpc_classify.needs: Current and new base plan prices.
pc_qpc_classify.example: New plan is cheaper than the old one; system classifies the change as a Downgrade.

pc_qpc_upgrade.title: Upgrade Plan Processing
pc_qpc_upgrade.does: Processes an Upgrade classification without a downgrade penalty or commitment break penalty per BR-MPC-003.
pc_qpc_upgrade.makes: Applicable charges displayed to the Retail Agent.
pc_qpc_upgrade.example: Customer upgrades to a higher plan; no penalty is applied.

pc_qpc_downgrade.title: Downgrade Plan Processing
pc_qpc_downgrade.does: Processes a Downgrade classification, applying the approved downgrade penalty matrix and lock-in penalty, effective immediately, per BR-MPC-004.
pc_qpc_downgrade.needs: Downgrade classification and applicable penalty matrix.
pc_qpc_downgrade.makes: Penalty presented before confirmation; rejection terminates the journey.
pc_qpc_downgrade.example: Customer downgrades; system shows the penalty and customer confirms.

pc_qpc_addon_carry.title: Add-On Carry Forward
pc_qpc_addon_carry.does: Removes bundled add-ons/discounts tied to the old plan while retaining independently purchased add-ons.
pc_qpc_addon_carry.needs: Old plan's bundled vs independent add-on/discount list.
pc_qpc_addon_carry.makes: Updated add-on/discount set for the new plan.
pc_qpc_addon_carry.example: Customer's bundled data add-on is removed on downgrade; their independently purchased roaming add-on is kept.

pc_qpc_addon_update.title: Add-On Update
pc_qpc_addon_update.does: Lets the agent add or remove add-ons during the plan-change journey.
pc_qpc_addon_update.makes: Updated add-on list on the order.
pc_qpc_addon_update.example: Agent adds a new international add-on during the plan change.

pc_qpc_discount_update.title: Discount Update
pc_qpc_discount_update.does: Lets the agent update the discount applied to the order.
pc_qpc_discount_update.example: Agent applies the latest loyalty discount to the new plan.

pc_qpc_sim_protect.title: SIM/MSISDN Protection
pc_qpc_sim_protect.does: Displays existing MSISDN and SIM details as read-only during the plan change, per BR-MPC-009.
pc_qpc_sim_protect.makes: Read-only MSISDN/SIM display in the cart.
pc_qpc_sim_protect.example: Agent sees the current MSISDN/SIM in the cart but cannot edit them.

pc_milestone_savecart1.title: Milestone: Cart Saved
pc_milestone_savecart1.does: Marks the cart-saved checkpoint for the Plan Change journey, reached directly or after Credit Limit Enhancement.
pc_milestone_savecart1.example: Agent saves the cart once plan selection and any CLE handling is complete.

pc_cle_raise_ticket.title: Raise a Ticket/Task
pc_cle_raise_ticket.does: Lets the agent raise a ticket/task to amend the customer's credit limit when the selected plan/add-on exceeds the default limit.
pc_cle_raise_ticket.needs: New plan/add-on exceeding default credit limit.
pc_cle_raise_ticket.example: Customer selects a plan above their credit limit; agent raises a CLE ticket.

pc_cle_assign.title: Assignment of Ticket/Task
pc_cle_assign.does: Assigns the CLE ticket/task to the relevant amendment authority team.
pc_cle_assign.makes: Ticket assigned to the designated team.
pc_cle_assign.example: CLE ticket routed to the segment's amendment-authority queue.

pc_cle_authority.title: Credit Limit Amendment Authority
pc_cle_authority.does: Restricts credit-limit amendment to privileged agents and to within the customer-segment ceiling, per BR-MPC-010.
pc_cle_authority.makes: Amendment applied within authority, or blocked.
pc_cle_authority.example: Non-privileged agent attempts an amendment and is blocked.

pc_cle_escalate.title: Credit Limit Escalation to Collections
pc_cle_escalate.does: Routes a request above the agent ceiling to Collections as an approval ticket per BR-MPC-010.
pc_cle_escalate.makes: Collections approval ticket; limit held until approved.
pc_cle_escalate.example: Requested limit exceeds what any Retail Agent may grant; routed to Collections.

pc_cle_advance_pay.title: Credit Limit Advance Payment Collection
pc_cle_advance_pay.does: Collects the delta between enhanced and default credit limit as a refundable deposit before the order is saved, per BR-MPC-011.
pc_cle_advance_pay.needs: Enhanced vs default credit limit delta.
pc_cle_advance_pay.example: Enhanced limit is QAR 500 above default; QAR 500 deposit is collected.

pc_cle_fin_advance_util.title: Advanced Payment Utilization
pc_cle_fin_advance_util.does: Adjusts the collected advance payment against the customer's next bill.
pc_cle_fin_advance_util.makes: Bill adjustment for the next cycle.
pc_cle_fin_advance_util.example: Next bill shows the advance payment applied as a credit.

pc_cle_fin_credit_note.title: Credit Note on Cancellation
pc_cle_fin_credit_note.does: Issues a credit note for the collected amount when an order carrying that payment is cancelled, per BR-MPC-012.
pc_cle_fin_credit_note.needs: Cancelled order with a collected payment.
pc_cle_fin_credit_note.makes: Credit note for the collected amount.
pc_cle_fin_credit_note.example: CLE order is cancelled after deposit collection; a credit note is issued.

pc_asg_retention.title: Re-Assigning Ticket to Retention Team
pc_asg_retention.does: Lets the agent reassign the ticket to the Retention Team when the plan change is a downgrade.
pc_asg_retention.makes: Reassigned ticket visible to Retention Team.
pc_asg_retention.example: Plan is downgraded; agent hands the ticket to Retention for a save.

pc_qpc_reopen_cart.title: Re-Opening the Saved Cart
pc_qpc_reopen_cart.does: Lets the Retention Agent reopen the saved cart and revise the plan after discussing with the customer.
pc_qpc_reopen_cart.needs: Saved cart from the downgrade path.
pc_qpc_reopen_cart.example: Retention Agent updates the plan after a retention conversation and re-saves the cart.

pc_cvc_ref.title: Cart Validation & Check Out (CVC Capability Reuse)
pc_cvc_ref.does: Reuses the CVC capability from Mobile Postpaid Activation for baseline cart validation.
pc_cvc_ref.example: Standard CVC validation runs before checkout.

pc_cvc_discount.title: Cart Discount
pc_cvc_discount.does: Overwrites the cart with the latest valid discount for the selected plan.
pc_cvc_discount.makes: Applied discount reflecting the latest plan.
pc_cvc_discount.example: Cart discount recalculates when the agent changes the plan selection.

pc_milestone_checkedout.title: Milestone: Cart Checked Out
pc_milestone_checkedout.does: Marks that the plan-change cart has passed validation and checkout, and is ready for payment.
pc_milestone_checkedout.example: Cart validation completes; agent proceeds to payment.

pc_pay_request.title: Payment Request to Payment Collection System
pc_pay_request.does: Displays the payment summary and collects payment via WinCash for the new plan/add-on, downgrade penalty, commitment-break penalty, and any CLE advance payment, per BR-MPC-006.
pc_pay_request.example: Customer pays the downgrade penalty plus new plan charge at the counter.

pc_pay_ref.title: Payment & Inventory (PAY Capability Reuse)
pc_pay_ref.does: Reuses the remaining PAY capability steps (failure/retry, receipt) from Mobile Postpaid Activation.
pc_pay_ref.example: Standard PAY failure/retry/receipt handling applies as in Postpaid Activation.

pc_ord_submit.title: Order Submission
pc_ord_submit.does: Lets the Retail Agent submit the order once all sections are complete and payment is completed, per BR-MPC-008.
pc_ord_submit.example: Agent clicks Submit once payment succeeds.

pc_ord_ref.title: Order Submission (ORD Capability Reuse)
pc_ord_ref.does: Reuses the ORD capability from Mobile Postpaid Activation for order orchestration/routing.

pc_not_ref.title: Notification & Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
pc_not_ref.does: Reuses the NOT capability from Mobile Postpaid Activation for customer notification.
pc_not_ref.example: Customer is notified of order submission/completion using the standard NOT flow.

pc_fin_billing.title: Billing Update
pc_fin_billing.does: Updates the billing system with the removed old plan/add-on/discount and the new plan/add-on/discount and their effective dates.
pc_fin_billing.example: Billing reflects the new plan from the next bill start date and the old plan closes at its bill end date.

pc_csa_feedback.title: Capture Ticket Feedback
pc_csa_feedback.does: Triggers a customer-satisfaction feedback survey where the feedback pattern is configured, per BR-MPC-013.
pc_csa_feedback.makes: Sent feedback trigger, or 'not applicable' marker.
pc_csa_feedback.example: Ticket closes and a CSAT survey is triggered per configuration.

pc_end.title: End of Plan Change Order Capture Journey
pc_end.does: Marks the end of the Plan Change (and Credit Limit Enhancement) order-capture journey.
pc_end.needs: Completed billing update and feedback trigger.
pc_end.example: Plan change is billed and the ticket is closed.

pmn_cam_search.title: Search Customer
pmn_cam_search.does: Allows the agent to search the customer by MSISDN, Customer No, First Name or Last Name and display Customer 360.
pmn_cam_search.makes: Customer 360 view for the matched customer.
pmn_cam_search.example: Agent searches by MSISDN and opens Customer 360.

pmn_cam_select.title: Customer Selection
pmn_cam_select.does: Lets the agent pick the specific MSISDN under a multi-MSISDN account for Park My Number.
pmn_cam_select.needs: List of MSISDN under the account.
pmn_cam_select.example: Customer has multiple lines; agent picks the one to park.

pmn_cam_initiate.title: Initiate Park My Number
pmn_cam_initiate.does: Lets the agent raise a Park My Number order for the selected MSISDN. Note: this row's original Req ID collided with 'Customer Selection' (both were PMN_001_CAM_02) — corrected to a distinct sequential New Req ID during workbook correction.
pmn_cam_initiate.example: Agent clicks 'Initiate Park My Number' for the selected line.

pmn_ecc_outstanding.title: Validate Outstanding Bill
pmn_ecc_outstanding.does: Blocks Park My Number until any outstanding bill is cleared, per BR-PMN-001.
pmn_ecc_outstanding.example: Customer has an unpaid bill; journey is blocked until it's cleared.

pmn_ecc_unbilled.title: Validate Current Unbilled Amount
pmn_ecc_unbilled.does: Blocks progression on unbilled amount until cleared or an approved exception is captured, per BR-PMN-001.
pmn_ecc_unbilled.example: Customer has a large unbilled usage amount; must clear or get an exception.

pmn_ecc_collections.title: Validate Collections Status
pmn_ecc_collections.does: Rejects Park My Number if the account is in collections, per BR-PMN-002.
pmn_ecc_collections.example: Account flagged in collections; Park My Number is rejected.

pmn_ecc_lockin.title: Validate Commitment/Lock-In
pmn_ecc_lockin.does: Checks whether the customer is under an active commitment (Star Number lock-in) before Park My Number, per BR-PMN-003.
pmn_ecc_lockin.example: Customer is on a Star Number plan with an active lock-in.

pmn_ecc_star_extend.title: Star Number Parked Period
pmn_ecc_star_extend.does: Extends the Star Number commitment duration by the parked period, per BR-PMN-003.
pmn_ecc_star_extend.example: Customer parks the number for 30 days; the Star Number commitment extends by 30 days.

pmn_ecc_eligibility.title: Park My Number Eligibility
pmn_ecc_eligibility.does: Validates that the MSISDN is eligible for Park My Number, limited to twice per year, per BR-PMN-006.
pmn_ecc_eligibility.needs: MSISDN's Park My Number usage history.
pmn_ecc_eligibility.example: MSISDN already parked twice this year; a third attempt is blocked with an error.

pmn_error_not_eligible.title: Error: Park My Number Not Eligible
pmn_error_not_eligible.does: Displays an error and stops the journey when the MSISDN is not eligible for another Park My Number.
pmn_error_not_eligible.example: Agent sees 'MSISDN not eligible for Park My Number' and cannot proceed.

pmn_qpc_ref.title: Product Catalogue & Cart (QPC Capability Reuse)
pmn_qpc_ref.does: Reuses the QPC capability from Mobile Postpaid Activation for baseline cart creation.
pmn_qpc_ref.example: Standard QPC flow runs before the Park-Plan-specific steps below.

pmn_qpc_fetch.title: Fetch Park Plan from Catalogue
pmn_qpc_fetch.does: Fetches the configured Park My Number plan from the product catalogue.
pmn_qpc_fetch.example: System retrieves the single configured Park Plan for assignment.

pmn_qpc_assign.title: Assign Park Plan
pmn_qpc_assign.does: Lets the agent assign the Park Plan to the existing MSISDN as the target plan, per BR-PMN-004.
pmn_qpc_assign.makes: Park Plan added to cart; order summary shows current-to-Park-Plan change.
pmn_qpc_assign.example: Agent assigns the Park Plan to the customer's line.

pmn_qpc_expire.title: Expire Current Active Plan
pmn_qpc_expire.does: Marks the existing active plan for expiry/deactivation once the Park Plan is assigned, per BR-PMN-005.
pmn_qpc_expire.makes: Existing plan expiry flag; MSISDN retained.
pmn_qpc_expire.example: Old plan is deactivated in the order once the Park Plan takes over.

pmn_qpc_retain.title: Retain MSISDN and SIM Details
pmn_qpc_retain.does: Displays the existing MSISDN and SIM as read-only during Park My Number, per BR-MPC-009.
pmn_qpc_retain.example: Agent sees the current MSISDN/SIM but cannot edit them while parking.

pmn_cvc_ref.title: Cart Validation & Check Out (CVC Capability Reuse)
pmn_cvc_ref.does: Reuses the CVC capability from Mobile Postpaid Activation for baseline cart validation.
pmn_cvc_ref.example: Standard CVC validation runs before checkout.

pmn_cvc_discount.title: Cart Discount
pmn_cvc_discount.does: Overwrites the cart with the latest valid discount for the selected plan.
pmn_cvc_discount.example: Discount recalculates for the Park Plan.

pmn_milestone_checkedout.title: Milestone: Cart Checked Out
pmn_milestone_checkedout.does: Marks that the Park My Number cart has passed validation and checkout.
pmn_milestone_checkedout.example: Cart validation completes; agent proceeds to payment.

pmn_pay_request.title: Payment Request to Payment Collection System
pmn_pay_request.does: Displays the payment summary and collects payment via WinCash for commitment-break penalty, Park Plan charges, and any bill due, per BR-MPC-006.
pmn_pay_request.example: Customer pays the Park My Number charge plus any outstanding dues.

pmn_pay_ref.title: Payment & Inventory (PAY Capability Reuse)
pmn_pay_ref.does: Reuses the remaining PAY capability steps (failure/retry, receipt) from Mobile Postpaid Activation.

pmn_ord_submit.title: Order Submission
pmn_ord_submit.does: Lets the Retail Agent submit the order once complete and paid, per BR-MPC-008.
pmn_ord_submit.example: Agent clicks Submit once payment succeeds.

pmn_ord_ref.title: Order Submission (ORD Capability Reuse)
pmn_ord_ref.does: Reuses the ORD capability for order orchestration/routing.

pmn_not_ref.title: Notification & Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
pmn_not_ref.does: Reuses the NOT capability for customer notification.
pmn_not_ref.example: Customer is notified of order completion.

pmn_fin_billing.title: Billing Update
pmn_fin_billing.does: Updates billing to continue generating bills for the Park My Number plan from its effective date.
pmn_fin_billing.example: Billing reflects the Park Plan from its effective date.

pmn_csa_feedback.title: Capture Ticket Feedback
pmn_csa_feedback.does: Triggers a CSAT survey where the feedback pattern is configured, per BR-MPC-013.
pmn_csa_feedback.makes: Sent feedback trigger, or 'not applicable' marker.
pmn_csa_feedback.example: Ticket closes and a CSAT survey is triggered per configuration.

pmn_end.title: End of Park My Number Order Capture Journey
pmn_end.does: Marks the end of the Park My Number order-capture journey.
pmn_end.needs: Completed billing update and feedback trigger.
pmn_end.example: Number is parked, billed, and the ticket is closed.

pmnr_jsm_ref.title: Journey and Session Management (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_jsm_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's JSM capability to start the Resume journey.
pmnr_jsm_ref.needs: Customer request to resume a parked number.
pmnr_jsm_ref.example: Customer returns and asks to resume their parked line.

pmnr_cav_ref.title: Customer Verification (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_cav_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's CAV capability.

pmnr_kyc_ref.title: Customer Identification (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_kyc_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's KYC capability.

pmnr_cre_ref.title: Ticket Creation (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_cre_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's ticket creation and categorisation capability.
pmnr_cre_ref.example: Standard CRE ticket creation runs for the resume request.

pmnr_cam_ref.title: Customer and Account Management (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_cam_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's Search Customer/Customer Selection/Initiate steps for the parked MSISDN.
pmnr_cam_ref.example: Agent searches and selects the parked line to resume it.

pmnr_ecc_ref.title: Eligibility and Credit Control (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_ecc_ref.does: Reuses baseline ECC from the Plan Change journey, before the resume-specific skip rule below.
pmnr_ecc_ref.example: Standard ECC checks run before the resume-specific skip below.

pmnr_ecc_skip.title: Skip Validation Checks on Lock-In, Cardinality and Compatibility
pmnr_ecc_skip.does: Skips lock-in, compatibility and cardinality checks so the agent can freely reassign a new or existing plan on resume.
pmnr_ecc_skip.example: Agent reassigns the customer's original (or a new) plan without being blocked by lock-in/cardinality/compatibility rules.

pmnr_qpc_ref.title: Product Catalogue and Cart (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_qpc_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's cart-creation capability for the resume order.
pmnr_qpc_ref.example: Cart is created with the reassigned plan.

pmnr_cvc_ref.title: Cart Validation & Check Out (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_cvc_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's checkout capability.
pmnr_cvc_ref.example: Standard CVC checkout runs for the resume order.

pmnr_pay_ref.title: Payment and Inventory (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_pay_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's payment capability.
pmnr_pay_ref.example: Standard PAY flow collects any resume-related charges.

pmnr_ord_ref.title: Order Submission (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_ord_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's order submission/orchestration capability.
pmnr_ord_ref.example: Resume order is submitted and routed to fulfilment.

pmnr_not_ref.title: Notification and Feedback (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_not_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's notification capability.
pmnr_not_ref.example: Customer is notified of the resume outcome.

pmnr_fin_billing.title: Billing Update
pmnr_fin_billing.does: Starts billing for the reassigned plan from its applicable effective date.
pmnr_fin_billing.example: Billing restarts on the reassigned plan once resume completes.

pmnr_ecc_star_continue.title: Star Number Lock Period Continues
pmnr_ecc_star_continue.does: Restarts the Star Number lock-in duration counter once the new plan is assigned on resume.
pmnr_ecc_star_continue.example: Star Number lock-in counter resumes counting after the resume order fulfils.

pmnr_csa_ref.title: Customer Satisfaction Feedback (Reuse: Plan Change)
pmnr_csa_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's CSAT feedback capability.
pmnr_csa_ref.makes: Feedback trigger sent, or marked not applicable.
pmnr_csa_ref.example: Standard CSAT survey triggers per configuration.

pmnr_end.title: End of Resume Order Capture Journey
pmnr_end.does: Marks the end of the customer-initiated Resume (Park My Number) journey.
pmnr_end.needs: Completed billing update and feedback trigger.
pmnr_end.example: Number is resumed, billed, and the ticket is closed.

disc_kyc_soft_id.title: Optional Soft ID Scan for Plan Change
disc_kyc_soft_id.does: Offers soft ID scanning only when the customer proceeds with a plan change after retention; skipped for direct termination.
disc_kyc_soft_id.makes: Recorded soft ID scan completion when invoked.
disc_kyc_soft_id.example: Customer accepts a retention plan change; agent performs a soft ID scan.

disc_cav_verify.title: Mandatory Lightweight Customer Verification
disc_cav_verify.does: Performs mandatory lightweight CAV via questionnaire before the journey progresses, per BR-MACD-001.
disc_cav_verify.example: Agent asks security questions before proceeding with disconnection.

disc_cam_search.title: Search Customer
disc_cam_search.does: Allows the agent to search the customer and display Customer 360, per BR-DISC-003.
disc_cam_search.example: Agent searches by MSISDN and opens Customer 360.

disc_cam_initiate.title: Initiate Termination
disc_cam_initiate.does: Lets the agent initiate a disconnect request; per BR-DISC-004, frontline agents cannot create the disconnection order directly — it must route through a Retention ticket.
disc_cam_initiate.example: Customer asks to disconnect; agent starts the termination flow, which routes to Retention.

disc_edd_dues.title: Display Dues and Lock-Ins
disc_edd_dues.does: Shows outstanding dues, DOI lock-ins, Star Number lock-in and plan lock-in penalties from Customer 360 for the Retention Agent's review, per BR-DISC-006.
disc_edd_dues.makes: Displayed dues/penalties before the retention decision.
disc_edd_dues.example: Retention Agent reviews the customer's outstanding bill and lock-in penalties before making a retention offer.

disc_pay_summary.title: Payment Summary View
disc_pay_summary.does: Displays outstanding dues and lock-in penalty charges to the agent.
disc_pay_summary.example: Agent sees a consolidated dues-and-penalty summary before creating the retention ticket.

disc_cre_retention_ticket.title: Create Retention Ticket
disc_cre_retention_ticket.does: Creates a retention ticket for the disconnection request before any save/termination decision, per BR-DISC-004.
disc_cre_retention_ticket.example: Retention ticket is raised the moment a customer asks to disconnect.

disc_asg_retention_team.title: Retention Team Work Assignment
disc_asg_retention_team.does: Assigns the retention ticket to the Retention queue for agent self-assignment, per BR-RET-003.
disc_asg_retention_team.makes: Ticket owned by a Retention Agent.
disc_asg_retention_team.example: Retention Agent picks up the ticket from the Retention queue.

disc_branch_offer.title: Retention Offer Outcome
disc_branch_offer.does: Represents the three possible outcomes of the retention conversation: retained on a different plan, rejected (proceeding to termination), or accepted as a migration to Prepaid instead of disconnection.
disc_branch_offer.needs: Retention offer presented to the customer.
disc_branch_offer.makes: Routing to the retained, cancelled/terminated, or migrate-to-Prepaid path.
disc_branch_offer.example: Customer either takes the retention offer, declines it, or asks to switch to Prepaid instead of disconnecting.

disc_qpc_retention_cart.title: Create Cart with Retention Plan/Add-On/Discount
disc_qpc_retention_cart.does: Lets the Retention Agent add an eligible retained postpaid plan, add-on or discount to the cart once the customer accepts the offer, per BR-DISC-007.
disc_qpc_retention_cart.example: Customer agrees to a discounted plan to stay; agent builds the retention cart.

disc_cvc_validate.title: Validate Retention Cart
disc_cvc_validate.does: Validates the retention cart before payment/submission, per BR-RET-001.
disc_cvc_validate.example: Cart validation confirms the retained plan/add-on/discount is consistent before checkout.

disc_pay_no_downgrade_charge.title: Plan Change Downgrade Payment Waiver
disc_pay_no_downgrade_charge.does: Waives the downgrade charge when the plan change is submitted from an active retention ticket, per BR-RET-007.
disc_pay_no_downgrade_charge.example: Customer downgrades as part of the retention offer; no downgrade penalty is applied.

disc_ord_submit_retained.title: Submit Retained Plan Order
disc_ord_submit_retained.does: Submits the retained plan/add-on/discount order after validation and payment, per BR-RET-002.
disc_ord_submit_retained.makes: Submitted order and updated tracking record.
disc_ord_submit_retained.example: Retained-plan order is submitted once payment (if any) completes.

disc_not_retained.title: Send Retained Outcome Notification
disc_not_retained.does: Sends a notification after the retained-plan order submits or the ticket closes, where configured, per BR-RET-004.
disc_not_retained.example: Customer receives confirmation of their new retained plan.

disc_res_close_retained.title: Close Retention Ticket for Retained Customer
disc_res_close_retained.does: Closes the retention ticket with a retained outcome and resolution reason, per BR-RET-005.
disc_res_close_retained.example: Ticket closes as 'Retained' once the new plan is active.

disc_fin_payment_adjustment.title: Payment Adjustment
disc_fin_payment_adjustment.does: Records any payment collected during the retention ticket as an adjustment on the customer's next bill, per BR-RET-008.
disc_fin_payment_adjustment.example: Any interim payment collected is credited on the next bill.

disc_csa_retained.title: Capture Retained Feedback
disc_csa_retained.does: Triggers CSAT feedback for the retained outcome where configured, per BR-RET-006.
disc_csa_retained.makes: Sent feedback trigger, or marked not applicable.
disc_csa_retained.example: Customer is asked to rate their retention experience.

disc_end_retained.title: End: Customer Retained
disc_end_retained.does: Marks the end of the journey for a customer who accepted a retention offer instead of disconnecting.
disc_end_retained.needs: Closed retention ticket with retained outcome.
disc_end_retained.example: Customer stays with Vodafone Qatar on a new plan.

disc_res_reject.title: Retention Offer Rejected
disc_res_reject.does: Records the customer's rejection of the retention offer and requests clearance of outstanding dues and lock-in penalties, per BR-DISC-009.
disc_res_reject.example: Customer declines retention and is asked to clear pending dues before disconnection proceeds.

disc_res_cancel_order.title: Termination Order Cancellation
disc_res_cancel_order.does: Cancels the termination request and closes the ticket if dues are not cleared within 72 hours, per BR-DISC-009.
disc_res_cancel_order.makes: Captured ticket ID/outstanding amount/closure reason; no disconnection order placed.
disc_res_cancel_order.example: Customer never pays outstanding dues within 72 hours; termination is cancelled and the ticket closed.

disc_res_dunning.title: Dues and Penalties Pending — Dunning
disc_res_dunning.does: Places the MSISDN into the Dunning cycle due to non-payment of pending penalties/dues.
disc_res_dunning.makes: MSISDN entered into the Dunning/Termination journey.
disc_res_dunning.example: Unpaid line rolls into the standard Dunning process for eventual termination.

disc_res_unreachable.title: Customer Not Reachable
disc_res_unreachable.does: Lets the Retention Agent submit the termination order and close the retention ticket if the customer is unreachable within 72 hours and dues are cleared, per BR-DISC-009.
disc_res_unreachable.makes: Placed disconnection order (if dues cleared) and closed ticket.
disc_res_unreachable.example: Customer cannot be reached; dues are already clear, so termination proceeds and the ticket closes.

disc_end_cancelled.title: End: Termination Cancelled
disc_end_cancelled.does: Marks the end of the journey where the termination request is cancelled because dues were never cleared.
disc_end_cancelled.example: Customer never clears dues; termination request lapses and closes.

disc_cvc_terminate.title: Capture Disconnection Order
disc_cvc_terminate.does: Captures the disconnection order details — reason, linked retention ticket, termination date, MSISDN — per BR-DISC-011.
disc_cvc_terminate.example: Agent records the termination reason and date for the confirmed disconnection.

disc_pay_terminate.title: Collect Termination Payment
disc_pay_terminate.does: Displays and collects Star Number penalty, DOI remaining instalment, outstanding dues and plan lock-in penalty, blocking progression until paid, per BR-DISC-006/011 and BR-PTPR-005.
disc_pay_terminate.example: Customer pays remaining lock-in penalty and dues before disconnection proceeds.

disc_ord_submit_terminate.title: Disconnection Order Submission
disc_ord_submit_terminate.does: Places the disconnection order once lock-in penalty and outstanding bill payment are complete, per BR-DISC-011.
disc_ord_submit_terminate.example: Agent submits the disconnection order once payment clears.

disc_net_deactivate.title: Deactivate Network Service
disc_net_deactivate.does: Deactivates the network service once the disconnection order enters fulfilment, per BR-DISC-016 (NET before NUM/SIM/FIN).
disc_net_deactivate.example: Line stops carrying service once network deactivation completes.

disc_num_update.title: Update Number Status
disc_num_update.does: Updates MSISDN status after network deactivation per number-management rules, per BR-DISC-016.
disc_num_update.example: MSISDN moves to a post-disconnection status per number-management policy.

disc_sim_deactivate.title: Deactivate SIM
disc_sim_deactivate.does: Updates/deactivates the SIM after the number status is processed, per BR-DISC-016.
disc_sim_deactivate.example: SIM record is deactivated once the number status update completes.

disc_fin_close.title: Complete Financial Closure
disc_fin_close.does: Completes financial account closure after fulfilment, with the final bill still generated at the current bill-cycle end (no Hot Bill), per BR-DISC-014/015.
disc_fin_close.makes: Recorded financial closure; scheduled final bill.
disc_fin_close.example: Account closes financially, but the customer's final bill still arrives at the normal cycle end.

disc_csa_survey.title: Send Feedback Survey
disc_csa_survey.does: Triggers a feedback survey only after termination fulfilment and resolution are complete, per BR-DISC-017.
disc_csa_survey.example: Customer receives an exit survey after disconnection completes.

disc_end_terminated.title: End: Customer Terminated
disc_end_terminated.does: Marks the end of the journey for a customer whose disconnection completed.
disc_end_terminated.needs: Completed financial closure and feedback survey.
disc_end_terminated.example: Line is disconnected and the retention case is closed.

disc_res_reject_migrate.title: Retention Offer Rejected — Migrate to Prepaid
disc_res_reject_migrate.does: Records the rejection reason plus the customer's Post-to-Pre migration request, and closes the retention ticket, per BR-DISC-009.
disc_res_reject_migrate.needs: Customer's decision to migrate instead of staying Postpaid.
disc_res_reject_migrate.makes: Recorded migration request; closed retention ticket.
disc_res_reject_migrate.example: Customer declines the retention offer but agrees to move to Prepaid instead of a clean disconnection.

disc_bam_adjustment_ticket.title: Raise Adjustment Ticket
disc_bam_adjustment_ticket.does: Raises a billing adjustment/refund ticket for the Postpaid-to-Prepaid billing profile change, crediting any advance payment to the Prepaid balance, per BR-DISC-012/013.
disc_bam_adjustment_ticket.needs: Postpaid billing history and any advance payment.
disc_bam_adjustment_ticket.example: Customer had an advance payment on the Postpaid account; it's credited to their new Prepaid balance.

disc_cam_ptp_initiate.title: Initiate Post to Pre
disc_cam_ptp_initiate.does: Restricts Post-to-Pre migration initiation to Mobile services with Connection Type Postpaid, per BR-PTPR-001.
disc_cam_ptp_initiate.example: Migration only proceeds for an eligible Mobile Postpaid line.

disc_kyc_ptp_soft_id.title: Optional Soft ID Scan for Post to Pre Plan Change
disc_kyc_ptp_soft_id.does: Offers optional soft ID scanning for the Post-to-Pre path after mandatory CAV.
disc_kyc_ptp_soft_id.example: Agent optionally re-scans ID as part of the Post-to-Pre migration.

disc_pay_ptp_collect.title: Collect Migration Payment
disc_pay_ptp_collect.does: Displays and collects lock-in penalties, DOI instalment, outstanding dues and migration fees, blocking progression until paid, per BR-PTPR-003/004/005.
disc_pay_ptp_collect.example: Customer pays lock-in penalties and dues before the Prepaid migration proceeds.

disc_qpc_ptp_cart.title: Post to Pre Cart Creation
disc_qpc_ptp_cart.does: Creates the Prepaid cart with eligible plan/add-ons/discounts; the Bill Limit is blank and SIM/MSISDN cannot be removed or updated, per BR-PTPR-007.
disc_qpc_ptp_cart.example: Agent builds the Prepaid cart, retaining the existing SIM/MSISDN.

disc_bam_ptp_profile.title: Billing Profile Update
disc_bam_ptp_profile.does: Removes Postpaid billing details and restricts billing-account selection since Prepaid has no billing profile, per BR-PTPR-008.
disc_bam_ptp_profile.example: Postpaid billing account details drop off once the line becomes Prepaid.

disc_cvc_ptp_validate.title: Validate Cart
disc_cvc_ptp_validate.does: Performs full customer/account/MSISDN/SIM/plan/eligibility/compatibility validation before payment, per BR-PTPR-009.
disc_cvc_ptp_validate.example: System blocks checkout until all migration validations pass.

disc_pay_ptp_process.title: Payment Processing
disc_pay_ptp_process.does: Processes the base plan/add-on payment through WinCash and updates CRM status; on failure the order is held for reattempt, per BR-PTPR-005/010.
disc_pay_ptp_process.example: Agent collects payment for the Prepaid base plan and any chargeable add-ons.

disc_caf_key_info.title: Key Information
disc_caf_key_info.does: Generates Prepaid-specific Terms and Conditions, reusing the rest of the CAF capability from Mobile Postpaid Activation.
disc_caf_key_info.example: Customer reviews the Prepaid terms and conditions before signing.

disc_caf_email.title: Send CAF Through Email
disc_caf_email.does: Lets the agent email the CAF documents when the customer isn't at the counter.
disc_caf_email.example: Remote customer receives the CAF by email instead of signing in person.

disc_caf_generate.title: CAF Generation and Submission
disc_caf_generate.does: Generates and saves the signed Prepaid CAF before submission, following the reused activation pattern, per BR-PTPR-013.
disc_caf_generate.example: Signed Prepaid CAF is saved to the order before the order is submitted.

disc_ord_ptp_submit.title: Order Submission and Migration
disc_ord_ptp_submit.does: Submits the Post-to-Pre order after payment, terminating the Postpaid connection only after Prepaid activation completes, per BR-PTPR-011.
disc_ord_ptp_submit.example: Prepaid line activates first, then the old Postpaid connection is terminated.

disc_not_ptp_submit.title: Customer Notification at Submission
disc_not_ptp_submit.does: Sends the order-submission notification through the customer's selected channel, per BR-PTPR-012.
disc_not_ptp_submit.example: Customer gets an SMS/email confirming the migration order was submitted.

disc_not_ptp_complete.title: Customer Notification Completion
disc_not_ptp_complete.does: Sends a completion acknowledgement to the customer and to all MSISDNs under the same QID where applicable, per BR-PTPR-012.
disc_not_ptp_complete.example: All lines under the same QID are informed once the Prepaid migration completes.

disc_end_ptp.title: End: Migrated to Prepaid, Postpaid Disconnected
disc_end_ptp.does: Marks the end of the journey for a customer who chose Prepaid migration over disconnection.
disc_end_ptp.example: Customer keeps their number on Prepaid instead of losing service entirely.

ptp_asg_queue.title: Assign to TeleSales Queue
ptp_asg_queue.does: Assigns the migration ticket to the Telesales queue for agent self-assignment. Reuses JSM/CAV/KYC/CRE (Trouble Ticket and Mobile Postpaid Activation journeys) before this step.
ptp_asg_queue.needs: Migration ticket created via reused JSM/CAV/KYC/CRE capabilities.
ptp_asg_queue.makes: Ticket owned by a Telesales Agent.
ptp_asg_queue.example: Telesales Agent picks up the Prepaid-to-Postpaid migration ticket from the queue.

ptp_cam_search_ref.title: Customer and Account Management (Reuse: Plan Change)
ptp_cam_search_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's Search Customer/Customer Selection steps.
ptp_cam_search_ref.makes: Customer 360 view for the matched customer.
ptp_cam_search_ref.example: Standard CAM search runs to locate the Prepaid customer.

ptp_cam_initiate_migration.title: Initiate Migration Order
ptp_cam_initiate_migration.does: Lets the Telesales Agent initiate a migration order from the selected active Prepaid service, linked to the Ticket, per BR-PTPO-005/007.
ptp_cam_initiate_migration.example: Agent starts the migration order from the customer's active Prepaid line.

ptp_kyc_ref.title: Customer Identification (KYC Capability Reuse)
ptp_kyc_ref.does: Reuses the Mobile Postpaid Activation KYC capability for re-verification before Postpaid onboarding.
ptp_kyc_ref.example: Standard KYC re-verification runs before the Postpaid activation journey.

ptp_cav_ref.title: Customer Verification — Light Weight (CAV Capability Reuse)
ptp_cav_ref.does: Reuses the Trouble Ticket journey's lightweight CAV capability for re-verification.
ptp_cav_ref.example: Lightweight verification questions confirm the customer's identity again before onboarding continues.

ptp_kyc_latest_identity.title: Latest Identity Type Eligibility
ptp_kyc_latest_identity.does: Uses the latest successfully verified identity type for Postpaid eligibility assessment, irrespective of the identity previously on the Prepaid profile, per BR-PTPO-009.
ptp_kyc_latest_identity.makes: Eligibility assessment based on the latest identity.
ptp_kyc_latest_identity.example: Customer previously verified with a visitor ID, now has a resident ID; eligibility uses the newer resident ID.

ptp_cam_refresh.title: Refresh Customer Information
ptp_cam_refresh.does: Updates the customer record with the latest MOI-verified information, per BR-PTPO-010.
ptp_cam_refresh.example: Customer's address/name updates in CRM to match their latest verified ID.

ptp_ecc_ref.title: Eligibility and Credit Control (ECC Capability Reuse)
ptp_ecc_ref.does: Reuses Mobile Postpaid Activation's ECC capability, subject to migration-specific rules below.
ptp_ecc_ref.example: Standard ECC checks run before the migration-specific eligibility checks.

ptp_ecc_prepaid_elig.title: Prepaid Service Migration Eligibility
ptp_ecc_prepaid_elig.does: Requires Mobile service, Prepaid connection type, Active status, active for more than 30 days, and recharge of at least QAR 50 in the last 30 days, per BR-PTPO-012.
ptp_ecc_prepaid_elig.needs: Service type, connection type, status, activity/recharge history.
ptp_ecc_prepaid_elig.example: Line has been active 45 days with QAR 60 recharged in the last month; migration proceeds.

ptp_ecc_postpaid_elig.title: Postpaid Service Migration Eligibility
ptp_ecc_postpaid_elig.does: Determines Postpaid eligibility from the latest verified identity type per the Postpaid Activation eligibility rule, per BR-PTPO-009.
ptp_ecc_postpaid_elig.example: Customer's latest ID type is one permitted for Postpaid; migration proceeds.

ptp_error_not_eligible.title: Error: Migration Not Eligible
ptp_error_not_eligible.does: Displays a distinct blocking message and stops the migration journey when Prepaid-service or Postpaid-identity eligibility fails.
ptp_error_not_eligible.example: Agent sees a specific error explaining why this line/customer cannot migrate to Postpaid.

ptp_bam_ref.title: Billing Account Management (BAM Capability Reuse)
ptp_bam_ref.does: Reuses Mobile Postpaid Activation's BAM capability for baseline billing account handling.
ptp_bam_ref.example: Standard BAM flow runs before the migration-specific billing account steps below.

ptp_bam_create_account.title: Create or Select Billing Account
ptp_bam_create_account.does: Lets the Telesales Agent create a new or select an existing eligible Postpaid billing account for the migrated MSISDN.
ptp_bam_create_account.example: Agent creates a new Postpaid billing account for the migrating customer.

ptp_bam_payment_profile.title: Postpaid Payment Profile
ptp_bam_payment_profile.does: Requires an active Postpaid payment profile before checkout is allowed.
ptp_bam_payment_profile.example: Checkout is blocked until a valid payment profile is set on the billing account.

ptp_milestone_cart_saved.title: Milestone: Migration Cart Saved
ptp_milestone_cart_saved.does: Marks that eligibility and billing profile capture are complete and the migration cart context is saved.
ptp_milestone_cart_saved.needs: Eligible customer with an active payment profile.
ptp_milestone_cart_saved.makes: Saved milestone before product cart creation.
ptp_milestone_cart_saved.example: Agent saves progress after eligibility and billing profile are confirmed.

ptp_qpc_ref.title: Product Catalogue and Cart (QPC Capability Reuse)
ptp_qpc_ref.does: Reuses Mobile Postpaid Activation's QPC capability, excluding new Number and SIM selection since these are retained.
ptp_qpc_ref.example: Standard QPC flow runs before the migration-specific retention rules below.

ptp_qpc_plan_selection.title: Eligible Postpaid Plan Selection
ptp_qpc_plan_selection.does: Displays only Postpaid base plans/add-ons/discounts the customer is eligible for based on the refreshed profile, per BR-PTPO-016.
ptp_qpc_plan_selection.example: Agent picks from the filtered list of Postpaid plans the customer qualifies for.

ptp_qpc_retain_msisdn.title: Retain Existing MSISDN
ptp_qpc_retain_msisdn.does: Carries the existing Prepaid MSISDN into the migration cart as read-only, per BR-PTPO-013.
ptp_qpc_retain_msisdn.example: Customer keeps their existing number through the migration.

ptp_qpc_retain_sim.title: Retain Existing SIM
ptp_qpc_retain_sim.does: Carries the existing Prepaid SIM/ICCID into the migration cart as read-only, per BR-PTPO-014.
ptp_qpc_retain_sim.example: Customer keeps their existing physical SIM through the migration.

ptp_qpc_new_promos.title: Apply New Postpaid Promotions
ptp_qpc_new_promos.does: Applies only the newly selected/defaulted Postpaid commercial products, excluding any Prepaid promotions, per BR-PTPO-016.
ptp_qpc_new_promos.makes: Order summary with new Postpaid products only.
ptp_qpc_new_promos.example: Order summary shows the new Postpaid plan; old Prepaid promotions are dropped.

ptp_cvc_ref.title: Cart Validation & Check Out (CVC Capability Reuse)
ptp_cvc_ref.does: Reuses Mobile Postpaid Activation's CVC capability, extended with retained-MSISDN/SIM validations, per BR-PTPO-018.
ptp_cvc_ref.example: Standard CVC checkout runs before the migration-specific validation below.

ptp_cvc_validate.title: Migration Cart Validation
ptp_cvc_validate.does: Validates customer, KYC, CAV, eligibility, billing account, payment profile, retained MSISDN/SIM and selected plan before checkout, per BR-PTPO-018.
ptp_cvc_validate.example: Checkout is blocked if, say, the payment profile is missing even though everything else passed.

ptp_cvc_summary.title: Migration Order Summary
ptp_cvc_summary.does: Displays a consolidated summary of terminated Prepaid products, retained MSISDN/SIM, new Postpaid plans, payable amount and prepaid balance treatment before confirmation.
ptp_cvc_summary.example: Agent and customer review the full before/after summary before confirming.

ptp_caf_reuse_decision.title: New Postpaid CAF Required?
ptp_caf_reuse_decision.does: Determines from configuration whether a new Postpaid CAF is required for the migration order, per BR-PTPO-020 (currently Open pending VFQ Business confirmation).
ptp_caf_reuse_decision.example: Configuration currently marks CAF requirement as Open pending business confirmation (see BR-PTPO-020 note).

ptp_caf_email.title: Send CAF Through Email
ptp_caf_email.does: Lets the agent email the CAF documents when the customer isn't at the counter.
ptp_caf_email.example: Remote customer receives the CAF by email instead of signing in person.

ptp_caf_key_info.title: Generate CAF Key Information (Postpaid Template)
ptp_caf_key_info.does: Follows the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's CAF template, content, signature and document rules where CAF is required/selected, per BR-PTPO-020.
ptp_caf_key_info.makes: CAF generated per the reused activation pattern.
ptp_caf_key_info.example: CAF follows the same template and signature rules as a fresh Postpaid activation.

ptp_pay_ref.title: Payment and Inventory (PAY Capability Reuse)
ptp_pay_ref.does: Reuses Mobile Postpaid Activation's PAY capability for request/failure/retry/receipt/billing-posting.
ptp_pay_ref.example: Standard PAY flow runs before the migration-specific payment summary below.

ptp_pay_summary.title: Migration Payment Summary
ptp_pay_summary.does: Itemises upfront Postpaid charges/deposits/migration charges and applies the remaining Prepaid balance as a credit, per BR-PTPO-017.
ptp_pay_summary.needs: Postpaid onboarding charges; remaining Prepaid balance.
ptp_pay_summary.makes: Itemised payment summary with balance credit applied.
ptp_pay_summary.example: Customer's leftover Prepaid balance offsets part of the new Postpaid deposit.

ptp_atv_balance_approval.title: Prepaid Balance Adjustment Approval
ptp_atv_balance_approval.does: Raises a Prepaid Balance Adjustment approval task and assigns it to the responsible agent/approver.
ptp_atv_balance_approval.example: A task is created for an approver to sign off on crediting the Prepaid balance.

ptp_atv_ref.title: Agent Task View (ATV Capability Reuse)
ptp_atv_ref.does: Reuses Agent 360's Agent Task View capability for the approver to see assigned tasks.
ptp_atv_ref.makes: Visible task in Agent Task View.
ptp_atv_ref.example: Approver sees the Prepaid Balance Adjustment task in their task list.

ptp_aav_ref.title: Agent Approval View (AAV Capability Reuse)
ptp_aav_ref.does: Reuses Agent 360's Agent Approval View capability for approve/reject/return-with-notes.
ptp_aav_ref.example: Approver opens the Agent Approval View to review and decide on the balance adjustment.

ptp_aav_restrict.title: Restrict Agent Action While Pending
ptp_aav_restrict.does: Blocks the Telesales Agent from submitting or dropping the order while it's pending approval; only the approver can decide, per BR-PTPO-033.
ptp_aav_restrict.makes: Blocked agent action; approver decision required.
ptp_aav_restrict.example: Agent tries to submit the order early; the system blocks it until approval completes.

ptp_ord_submit.title: Migration Order Submission
ptp_ord_submit.does: Lets the Telesales Agent submit the migration order once all sections, validations, CAF decision and payment are complete, per BR-PTPO-022.
ptp_ord_submit.example: Agent clicks Submit once payment status is Paid or Zero Value Completed.

ptp_ord_route.title: Route Migration for Fulfilment
ptp_ord_route.does: Sends the complete migration order (retained MSISDN/SIM, terminated Prepaid plans, Postpaid billing account, selected products) to Order Management, per BR-PTPO-023.
ptp_ord_route.example: Order Management receives every line item needed to execute the migration.

ptp_ord_link_ticket.title: Migration Order Linked to Ticket
ptp_ord_link_ticket.does: Links the migration order number and status to the originating Ticket, per BR-PTPO-007.
ptp_ord_link_ticket.example: Ticket shows the live migration order number and status for agent tracking.

ptp_not_ref.title: Notification and Feedback (NOT Capability Reuse)
ptp_not_ref.does: Reuses the Mobile Postpaid Activation journey's NOT capability for baseline notification.
ptp_not_ref.example: Standard NOT flow runs before the migration-specific template below.

ptp_not_migration_template.title: Migration Template Notification
ptp_not_migration_template.does: Notifies the customer using the preconfigured Pre-to-Post template when the migration order is submitted, per BR-PTPO-032.
ptp_not_migration_template.example: Customer receives the migration-specific SMS/email template.

ptp_fin_terminate_prepaid.title: Terminate Prepaid Subscription
ptp_fin_terminate_prepaid.does: Terminates the Prepaid subscription and all associated commercial products only on successful migration completion, per BR-PTPO-015.
ptp_fin_terminate_prepaid.example: Old Prepaid plan, bundles and promotions all close out once Postpaid activates.

ptp_fin_balance_adjustment.title: Prepaid Balance Adjustment
ptp_fin_balance_adjustment.does: Transfers the Prepaid main balance as a credit to the Postpaid billing account, per BR-PTPO-017.
ptp_fin_balance_adjustment.example: Leftover Prepaid balance shows as a credit on the new Postpaid bill.

ptp_fin_activate_billing.title: Activate Postpaid Billing
ptp_fin_activate_billing.does: Activates Postpaid billing for the selected products from the migration completion date, per BR-PTPO-024.
ptp_fin_activate_billing.needs: Migration completion date; selected Postpaid products.
ptp_fin_activate_billing.makes: Active Postpaid billing with recurring/one-time charges.
ptp_fin_activate_billing.example: Postpaid billing starts on the exact date migration completes.

ptp_fin_retain_after.title: Retain MSISDN and SIM After Migration
ptp_fin_retain_after.does: Confirms the completed Postpaid subscription keeps the same MSISDN and SIM/ICCID as the terminated Prepaid subscription, per BR-PTPO-013/014.
ptp_fin_retain_after.makes: Retained MSISDN/SIM on the new Postpaid subscription.
ptp_fin_retain_after.example: Customer's number and physical SIM carry over unchanged into Postpaid.

ptp_ord_complete.title: Order and Ticket Completion
ptp_ord_complete.does: Sets the migration order to Completed, updates the Tracking Record and closes the Ticket with the migration outcome, per BR-PTPO-025.
ptp_ord_complete.makes: Completed order; closed Ticket with outcome.
ptp_ord_complete.example: Ticket closes as 'Migration Completed' once billing activates.

ptp_csa_ref.title: Customer Satisfaction Feedback (CSA Capability Reuse)
ptp_csa_ref.does: Reuses the Plan Change journey's CSAT feedback capability.
ptp_csa_ref.makes: Feedback trigger sent, or marked not applicable.
ptp_csa_ref.example: Standard CSAT survey triggers per configuration.

ptp_end.title: End of Prepaid-to-Postpaid Migration Journey
ptp_end.does: Marks the end of the Prepaid-to-Postpaid Migration journey.
ptp_end.example: Customer is now fully onboarded as Postpaid with the same number and SIM.
